title: Savannah Chrisley married Jason Galanis before revealing pregnancy

 Melina Khan USA TODAY Nov. 2, 2026, 10:42 a.m. ET Hear this story Savannah Chrisley is already a married woman.
 Days after the reality TV personality announced her pregnancy and engagement on social media Oct. 27, she confirmed that she quietly tied the knot over the summer.
 "We ended up getting married in the Cayman Islands in July," the 29-year-old said in a Nov. 1 YouTube video with former NFL star Golden Tate.
 Chrisley has largely kept details about her spouse private, only identifying him by first name Jason. People and Us Magazine confirmed the former "Chrisley Knows Best" star's partner is Jason Galanis, a 56-year-old businessman.
 Just two days after revealing her pregnancy and engagement, news emerged that she and Galanis had quietly tied the knot over the summer. People magazine was the first to confirm the news on Oct. 29.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. The couple married in the Cayman Islands on July 24, two days before Galanis' birthday, according to marriage records obtained by People.
 USA TODAY has reached out to a representative for Chrisley for comment.
 Savannah Chrisley says she is married, still planning 2027 wedding
 On an Oct. 27 episode of her "Unlocked with Savannah Chrisley" podcast, Chrisley revealed she is planning a May 2027 wedding. She reiterated the plans to Tate despite revealing that the couple is already married.
 "We did our like everything (in the Cayman Islands), but we haven't filed it here or else then it would be public record," she said. "But wedding is in May."
 Chrisley and Galanis got engaged in December 2025 after five months of dating, she said on her podcast.
 The same day the Oct. 27 podcast episode dropped, she took to Instagram to share that she is pregnant with her first child.
 "I once prayed just to make it through another day. Now I get to spend forever with the love of my life, carrying a little miracle we already love more than words," she wrote in the caption.
 Todd Chrisley praised his daughter's relationship with Galanis in an Oct. 29 appearance on Bunnie Xo's "Dumb Blonde" podcast, although he said the couple's 20-year age gap was not something he "embraced" at first. He also seemingly hinted at the couple being married already, saying, "You've got all these comments. 'Oh, she's having a child out of wedlock.' Is she?"
 Galanis was sentenced to more than 15 years in prison for multiple fraud schemes in 2020, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office, though President Donald Trump granted him clemency in March 2025.

Naomi Osaka, Olandria weigh in on dream possibilities Christina Applegate details new medical testing after MS misdiagnosis Pierce Brosnan thinks this star would be great as the next James Bond Elizabeth Holmes' partner addresses 'You Can See Everything' nude scene Savannah Chrisley shares pregnancy journey
 Chrisley revealed on her podcast that she found out she was pregnant amid a journey with in vitro fertilization , an assisted reproductive process where eggs and sperm are combined in a lab to create an embryo.
 Because she has both endometriosis and adenomyosis – conditions that impact tissue in the uterus – doctors had told her she might have difficulty getting pregnant, she said.
 "It's been really hard to be in this season of life of being super happy for people who are getting pregnant when you yourself know that could potentially not happen for you," she said.
 Ultimately, she said she unexpectedly found out she was pregnant while on vacation about a month after undergoing the egg retrieval process.
 "That test came back within like 10 seconds. Two bright pink lines. And I was like, 'Stop it. No.' There was no way," she said of finding out she was pregnant. She said she is currently almost 21 weeks pregnant.
